statement: Pinned public host implementations provide distinct direct hidraw/feature-report and kernel-derived evdev consumer paths for DualSense. A virtual DualSense UHID node's host driver/SDL backend must be observed rather than assumed from VID/PID or mapping database.

applicability.revision: source revisions pinned in part 1 and G, host versions not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer-routing documentation only: SDL PS5 requests feature 0x09/0x20/0x05, parses USB report 0x01 and sends output 0x02; kernel hid-playstation probes feature/identity and drives FF/LED. Wine has explicit Sony BT hidraw fixups. No actual Steam, SDL, browser, Wine, InputPlumber or emulator host test was run. Additional independent source pin: Chromium Gamepad Linux udev input/hidraw enumeration; WebHID has both static and dynamic protection rules. InputPlumber source matching is version-scoped and does not assert a local host pass.
